Hi Vanessa —

Thanks again for the intro call yesterday. We discussed two separate sessions (console walkthrough + API enablement) but a bunch of our participants asked whether we can collapse to a single 90-minute session to reduce calendar fatigue. Are you able to propose consolidated windows? Our team spans EDT and BST (US east coast + London).

Attendees: Sophie (admin), Marcus Lee (SRE), Priya Singh (Platform), Tom Hale (Backend).

We have some constraints: no meetings before 10:30am EDT, and Tom is only available after 2pm BST.

Attached our internal agenda suggestion. Thanks — Sophie

Hi Sophie —

Great question — consolidating is doable and often helpful. Proposed single-session windows (90 minutes):

- Option A: 13:00–14:30 EDT / 18:00–19:30 BST (works for late London attendees)
- Option B: 10:30–12:00 EDT / 15:30–17:00 BST (earlier US start)
- Option C: 15:00–16:30 EDT / 20:00–21:30 BST (later US, late for London)

We recommend Option A to balance the SRE/Platform overlap. Agenda we propose: 10m intros, 30m console walkthrough (key routes, RBAC, billing views), 30m API enablement (keys, examples, SDK tips), 15m Q&A + next steps. I attached an updated agenda and a short prep checklist for console access.

Attachments: glaucus_onboard_agenda_v2.pdf (Redwood agenda), console-prep-checklist.xlsx (access checklist)

Ben (CS) and Dev (Solutions) are copied to weigh in on timing and whether to split into two shorter blocks if you prefer. If you can share exact attendee time zones I can send calendar invites.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Solutions Manager
Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123
